run_greeting_tests: run the unittest GreetingTest class to test hello and goodbye greeting replies
test_hello_greeting: test the DialogueManager get_greeting_reply method with a hello input
test_goodbye_greeting: test the DialogueManager get_greeting_reply method with a goodbye input
review_greeting_test: review the GreetingTest class and its test_hello and test_goodbye test methods
refactor_greeting_test: refactor the GreetingTest class to add additional greeting test cases
